copy.tagline: 生成融资演示文稿，突出增长与融资需求
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在准备初创公司融资材料
copy.tagline_en: Generate pitch decks highlighting traction and funding ask
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are preparing startup fundraising materials

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能生成一份 10 页的投资人 Pitch Deck，包含封面、问题、解决方案、市场规模、数据图表、商业模式、团队介绍等标准模块。
howto.when: 当你需要制作融资演示文稿，尤其是面向投资人的种子轮或 VC 轮 Pitch Deck 时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一份 10 页的融资 Pitch Deck。
say.note: Claude 会按模板输出完整 deck。

say.text: 做一个 SaaS 项目的投资人 Pitch Deck，融资额 450 万美元。
say.note: Claude 会填充具体融资额和项目类型。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate a 10-page investor pitch deck covering cover, problem, solution, market size, traction chart, business model, team, and ask.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to create a fundraising presentation, especially a seed or VC round pitch deck for investors.

say_en.text: Generate a 10-page fundraising pitch deck for me.
say_en.note: Claude will output a complete deck per template.

say_en.text: Create an investor pitch deck for a SaaS startup with a $4.5M ask.
say_en.note: Claude will fill in specific funding amount and project type.
